stem: A manager sees Key events in one GA4 report and Conversions in the Advertising section, with different numbers for the same sign-up, and asks which of the two is right. What is the accurate answer?

options.text: Key events: Conversions is the old name, and the Advertising section still shows the old figures
Conversions: a key event is only a draft until an Administrator approves it as a conversion
They are the same metric, and the gap comes from data thresholds in the Advertising section
Both: key events are what GA4 counts, and conversions are Google Ads conversions made from them
